props.name: mode
props.description: What the bar's colour and icon say about the value. The bar is low up to 80% of the range, high above 80%, full at 100% and exceeded above `maxValue`. - `default`: more is worse. Low is success, high is a warning, and full or exceeded is an error. High, full and exceeded show the warning icon. - `inverted`: more is better. Low is an error, high is a warning, full is success and exceeded is an error, with no icon. - `success-only-when-full`: only full is success, with the success icon. Every other level is an error with the warning icon. - `neutral`: the primary colour at every level, with no icon.
